title: Respondus publishes separate Monitor student terms and processes student/examinee personal information
summary: Respondus's public privacy policy covers services to institutions and distinguishes Students (including examinees/test takers) from instructors. It references Respondus Monitor institution and student terms of use. Combined with CSUSB listing Respondus Monitor on Canvas Learning Apps, this documents a vendor privacy regime for proctoring-capable software beyond the campus website Privacy Notice.
student_action: Read Respondus Monitor student terms before any webcam exam; ask the instructor what is recorded and retained.
school_action: Link Respondus Monitor student terms from course syllabi when Monitor is required.
